title: Supervisor De Varejo
description:
Please submit your CV in English—we will only consider applications submitted in this language.

Position: Retail Supervisor

Location: São Paulo / SP – On-site

What we are looking for

We are looking for a Retail Supervisor who is proactive, dynamic, and driven by results. This professional will be responsible for leading the development and execution of training programs for promoters and retail partners, as well as coordinating and supervising store staff to ensure the highest standards of customer service and product presentation. The goal is to deliver the best possible retail experience and uphold realme’s brand excellence across all points of sale.

Responsibilities
  • Translate and compile training manuals from English to Portuguese, standardized scripts, display guidelines, and other instructional materials, regularly refining the content;
  • Establish a training structure for promoters, developing training programs and procedures (covering basic training, product knowledge, sales techniques, etc.);

Train partner staff (coordination with Fastshop, Magalu, Casas Bahia, etc. is required) to help sell realme products.

Teach promoters and partner staff how to display realme products and Point of Sale Materials (POSM) in each store, coordinating with the main store to obtain a better display position for realme in each store.

Organize and conduct centralized in-person training sessions or coaching visits to stores for sales assistants, ensuring training coverage and effectiveness.

Manage sales assistant evaluation mechanisms, track KPI performance and feedback, and conduct regular exams and evaluations.

Develop a plan for each store to prepare the type of POS, especially when new products are launched or when old products are discontinued.

Assist in establishing brand standard implementation procedures, driving the execution of in-store displays, uniforms, point-of-purchase (POP) materials, etc.

Requirements
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in retail training or sales management, with familiarity with sales assistant management models;
  • Proficiency in communication, expression, and team motivation, with proven ability to lead teams and deliver training;
  • Ability to communicate with headquarters in English, proficiency in creating PPTs / videos / training evaluation forms;
  • Availability to travel for work, visiting stores in São Paulo and neighboring cities;
  • Fluency in English (Chinese – Mandarin, will be a plus);
  • Preference for candidates with experience in the mobile phone / digital 3C industry, understanding of FD systems and retail store operating mechanisms;

Candidates with experience working with TCL, Magalu, CasasBahia, Fastshop, Lojas Cem, etc., NKA smartphones, LKA channel will be given priority.

About us

Blinq Tecnologia is a start-up company operating in the smartphone market with a focus on providing superior and affordable experiences for younger audiences. We have been operating in partnership with realme since 2018, the fastest-growing smartphone brand in the world, active in 61 markets globally, including China, India, Southeast Asia, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa, with a total of more than 300 million users around the globe.

If you meet the criteria and want to be part of this story, send us your CV!

  • Gestão de Performance: Gerenciar a performance e elaborar planos de ação por Distribuidor/Ambiente de Varejo/Loja.

  • Comunicação e Treinamento: Realizar comunicação e treinamento de Distribuidores/Representantes de Vendas.

  • Criação de Proximidade: Criar proximidade com a rotina, ferramentas e comportamento do representante de vendas, além da compreensão dos protocolos comerciais do distribuidor.

  • Implementação e Acompanhamento de KPIs: Implementar e rastrear KPIs e incentivos de projetos B2B e do Canal Indireto por Distribuidor/Equipe de Vendas.

  • Execução do Calendário Digital: Executar o calendário digital de forma adequada, totalmente alinhado com a estratégia offline.

  • Gestão Financeira do Canal B2B: Gerenciar Investimentos, ROI e P&L do Canal B2B – garantindo que não haja gastos excessivos (no overspending).

  • Principais Interfaces: Interagir com Proprietários de DBs, Representantes de Vendas, Força de Vendas NIVEA e Proprietários de Lojas.

  • Habilidade de Vendas & Comunicação: Capacidade de transitar e "falar a mesma língua" em diferentes níveis hierárquicos, desde proprietários de distribuidores e executivos até a operação de campo (representantes, merchandisers e lojas).

  • Proatividade e Confiabilidade: Ser proativo, com aptidão para fazer as coisas acontecerem (getting things done), e ser um bom team player em um ambiente dinâmico.

  • Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade robusta de pensamento crítico e resolução de problemas.

Conhecimento e Experiência Requeridos:

title: Head Of Operational Excellence
description:
Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from São Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

Head of Charging Operations

As the Head of Charging Operations, you will be the executive leader responsible for defining and executing the strategy for the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Vammo's battery-swapping network which is the heart of our customer experience.

Reporting directly to the Founders, you will build and lead the organization that ensures not only the expansion of our charging network, but also its 24/7 operation. You will be the ultimate owner of this network efficiency and quality, managing the LiveOps, Field Operations, and Commercial Charging Teams, being responsible for preparing the area for 10x growth. This is a mission-critical leadership role that demands strategic vision, the ability to build high-performance teams, and a deep sense of ownership.

  • Define the end-to-end Charging Ops strategy, including the detailed strategic plan and OKRs. Own the design of processes, systems, and team architecture required to scale the operation by 10x, improve efficiency, and increase customer satisfaction.
  • Own the area's full budget and P&L, managing and optimizing costs to meet company goals.
  • Define and monitor the area's core OKRs and KPIs.
  • Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams across LiveOps, Field Operations, and Infrastructure. Define the area's vision and culture, focusing on urgency, accountability, and data-driven problem-solving.
  • Serve as the ultimate owner of network uptime, reliability, and incident response, ensuring riders always have batteries available.
  • Own the end-to-end energy strategy to reduce cost per kWh, including managing procurement, exploring free market (Mercado Livre) opportunities, and implementing efficiency initiatives.
  • Lead the commercial and expansion strategy for the network, defining site selection criteria to secure prime locations and network balance, negotiating strategic partnerships, and overseeing installation/launch playbooks.
  • Build proactive Customer Experience (CX) processes to communicate downtime and protect our NPS.
  • Serve as the strategic voice of operations for the Product and Engineering teams, providing real-world feedback and guiding the hardware/software roadmap to improve operability.
  • Act as the final escalation point for critical incidents, conduct post-mortems, and implement structural changes to prevent recurrence.
What We're Looking For
  • 8-12 years professional experience
  • Excellent knowledge of Brazil and Latin American business practices
  • Track record scoping, building, training and leading large multidisciplinary teams
  • Proven expertise in process design, optimization, and creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for large-scale operation
  • An analytical and strategic mindset, with strong data-driven decision-making skills and experience defining OKRs
  • Executive communication and influencing skills, capable of aligning tech, executive, and field teams.
  • Excels in planning and executing initiatives of varying durations and scales while effectively managing stakeholders.
  • Fosters collaborative and respectful work environments
  • Technical Curiosity, a drive to understand how systems, hardware, and data truly work and how to optimize them.
  • Experience in high-growth (hyper-growth) startups
  • Experience managing 24/7 systems.
  • Experience setting and leading priorities, objectives and strategic direction for entire orgs
  • Experience in mobility, energy, logistics, IoT, or telecommunications is a plus.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Strong alignment with the company’s values
  • A leadership role at fast-growing startup changing the face of mobility in Latin America, backed by some of the best venture capitalists in the world
  • Working at a mission driven company - we are reducing carbon emissions across the world and putting more money into the pocket of disenfranchised populations
  • Being surrounded by a talented and ambitious team that wants to build something big
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you dare, allowing you to develop quickly
  • Competitive salary package
  • Opportunity to own a piece of the company - equity package
  • Health Insurance

Vammo is an Equal Opportunity / Affinitive Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Head of Rider Experience

Let’s talk about Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, one of the world’s largest tech and delivery ecosystems, with a bold mission: help people eat better and live better.

With that vision in mind, we’re expanding globally and getting ready to launch our app in Brazil and we’re looking for extraordinary people to join us on this journey of growth and innovation.

The Head of Courier Experience will lead all initiatives related to equipment, benefits and the daily experience of riders in Brazil.

The role blends strategy and hands‑on execution as you will build the long-term structure while operating key processes directly.

  • Lead procurement and negotiation with suppliers of all rider equipment
  • Manage inventory accuracy, forecasting and multi-city distribution
  • Develop benefit and loyalty initiatives to improve rider experience

  • Strong experience in CX and engagement
  • Excellent negotiation and vendor management skills
  • Highly data-driven profile with strong analytical thinking; SQL skills are a significant plus
  • Hands-on profile comfortable with fast-paced environments
  • Availability to work on-site in São Paulo and advanced English preferred
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.
Responsibilities
  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.
What We’re Looking For
  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.
Why Downstream
  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

Desde a sua fundação tem o slogan "Nós Confiamos em Deus", mote que reflete o propósito da Cargolift que é transformar a vida de pessoas, instruindo-as no caminho em que devem andar, ao lado de Jesus.

A vontade de usar o empreendedorismo como ferramenta de fomentar o bem-estar social também levou a Cargolift a trazer ao Brasil o movimento “Corajosamente Éticos”, que busca unir pessoas físicas e jurídicas numa mesma causa: o Brasil. title: Web Experience Manager
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we're blending technology and real-world expertise to empower small businesses across the U.S. like never before.

We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That's why we're on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and grow sustainably without the hassle.

The Olly Olly platform complements our hands‑on service perfectly: it's no‑nonsense, easy‑to‑use software that helps local businesses streamline operations, drive leads, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can focus on what they do best.

Why We Need You

We're building a high-volume production operation where design excellence is non‑negotiable, and we need a leader who's obsessed with perfection at scale.

As Web Experience Manager, you'll lead a team of Web Production Specialists responsible for building 500+ new websites monthly while handling thousands of page additions, content updates, and client‑requested edits. This is assembly‑line speed with boutique‑level quality—teaching your team to work fast without cutting corners, to batch similar tasks efficiently, and to maintain exceptional standards even when the pipeline is full.

Design is everything. You understand that a poorly chosen photo destroys credibility in seconds, that sloppy typography signals “cheap template,” and that lazy layout decisions cost our clients actual business. You can look at a page for 30 seconds and identify exactly what's undermining conversion—misaligned elements, weak visual hierarchy, photos that scream stock mediocrity, CTAs that don't command attention.

This role requires active quality leadership: You're spot‑checking your team's work daily and teaching them what best‑in‑class looks like. When you catch the misaligned button, the weak photo crop, the headline that's too long for the layout, or the CTA that doesn't pop, you're coaching the team to recognize and fix these issues themselves. You're providing specific, design‑focused feedback: “This hero image undermines trust because the lighting looks artificial,” “The typography hierarchy here buries the most important message,” “This layout guides the eye away from the CTA instead of toward it.”

You're not managing from reports. You're in Figma, WordPress, and live sites daily—looking at actual pages your team built, questioning choices, and coaching them to see what you see.

The Impact You'll Have

Design quality obsession: Personally review completed pages daily—not for completion, but for excellence. Inspect typography choices, image selection, visual hierarchy, spacing, mobile responsiveness, and conversion optimization. Nothing ships unless it meets your exacting standards.

Hands‑on inspection

You're not delegating quality control—you're the final pair of eyes on work before it goes to clients. You catch the misaligned button, the weak photo crop, the headline that's too long for the layout, the CTA that doesn't pop.

Specific, design‑focused feedback: Provide daily coaching that teaches why design choices matter: “This doesn't work because…” and “Here’s what would be stronger…” You're building your team's design judgment through detailed, actionable critiques on real work.

Evolving standards in real‑time: Continuously update design guidelines, templates, and best practices as you learn what's converting. When you spot a pattern that works, you document it and train the team on it immediately. When something stops performing, you kill it fast.

Team development through craft: Manage up 15 Web Production Specialists to see design the way you do—training them to spot credibility killers, recognize weak visual hierarchy, and make choices that actually convert instead of just looking “done.”

Design system creation: Build and maintain comprehensive visual guidelines that scale your judgment across the team—covering everything from image selection criteria to typography standards to layout principles that guide visitors toward action.

Workflow optimization without quality compromise: Design production processes that maintain velocity while preserving the time needed for genuine design thinking. When timelines pressure quality, you push back.

Cross‑functional design advocacy: Partner with Implementation Managers and Onboarding Specialists to ensure strategic briefs translate into visually exceptional execution. You're the voice that says “this design won’t convert” when others just see completion.

Capacity and performance management: Track team bandwidth, distribute work strategically, monitor individual quality trends, and provide developmental feedback focused on elevating design craft.

Staying ahead of the curve: Regularly research competitive sites, high‑converting designs across industries, emerging visual trends, and new tools or techniques that could improve output quality.

Core Requirements

Uncompromising design standards: You're borderline obsessive about visual quality. You notice 2‑pixel misalignments, mediocre photo crops, and typography choices that undermine credibility. “Good enough” bothers you when “excellent” is achievable.

Active inspection mindset: You WILL review actual work daily—looking at real pages, providing specific feedback, and catching quality issues before they reach clients. This is non‑negotiable and takes significant daily time.

3‑5 years managing creative or production teams in digital marketing, agency, or web design environments with proven ability to maintain design excellence at scale.

Design director‑level eye: You can evaluate a page in 30 seconds and identify exactly what's preventing conversion—whether it's visual hierarchy, image credibility, CTA prominence, white space, typography, or mobile experience.

Intelligent content implementation: Oversee the process of taking structured data from onboarding forms and transforming it into high‑converting WordPress pages. Your team uses client‑provided photos enhanced through AI tools to create professional‑quality visuals, combines form data with strategic copy, and implements everything with proper schema markup and SEO optimization.

Solid SEO fundamentals: Understanding of schema markup, technical on‑page optimization, how content structure affects ranking, and the relationship between design decisions and SEO performance.

WordPress mastery
  • Advanced understanding of Gutenberg, Elementor, WP Bakery, and other page builders
  • Working knowledge of theme architecture, constraints, and customization possibilities
  • Ability to evaluate whether design limitations are real or just assumed

Conversion‑focused design expertise: Deep understanding of the psychology behind visual design choices—how imagery affects trust, how layout guides behavior, how typography signals quality, how white space impacts focus.

Adaptive learning orientation: You actively study what's working now, not what worked two years ago. You're constantly testing assumptions, researching trends, and updating your approach based on performance data and industry evolution.

Coaching through critique: You can explain precisely why a design choice works or fails, helping designers develop judgment rather than just following rules. Your feedback makes people better at seeing what you see.

3‑5 years performance management experience: Track record of setting clear quality expectations, providing developmental feedback, addressing performance issues directly, and elevating team capabilities through hands‑on coaching.

Remote team leadership: Experience managing distributed teams across time zones with strong asynchronous communication and clear documentation of standards.

Comfortable with being the bad guy: You're willing to send work back, challenge timelines when they compromise quality, and be the person who says “this isn’t ready” when everyone else wants to ship.

Quality metrics thinking: You track revision rates, client feedback patterns, conversion performance data, and team output quality—using data to identify where standards are slipping and where training is needed.

What Would Be Big Pluses
  • Portfolio demonstrating your own exceptional design work and aesthetic judgment
  • Experience implementing and evolving design systems across growing teams
  • Background in conversion rate optimization with A / B testing experience
  • Formal training in graphic design, UX / UI design, or visual communication
  • Experience scaling creative operations while maintaining (or improving) quality standards
  • Previous work in high‑volume agency environments where design quality was the primary differentiator
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and how they impact design decisions
  • Understanding of technical SEO considerations that constrain or enable design choices
Salary: Competitive; Based on Experience

Flexible work: 100% remote, with core hours for collaboration (8 AM – 5 PM EST, Mon–Fri)

Work-life balance: 15 vacation days + U.S. holidays

Design‑first culture: You'll work for a CEO who believes design quality directly determines whether small businesses win or lose online. Your standards will be supported, not questioned.

Growth path

This role is the foundation for becoming Director of Production or VP of Creative Operations. You'll build systems that scale design excellence, develop leadership capabilities, and prove that craft and volume aren't mutually exclusive.

Real impact

Your obsession with quality will directly determine whether 17,000+ small businesses outperform or lose to competitors. Every page you perfect translates to actual revenue for a real contractor, attorney, or home services business.

Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

SAP/ERP Consultant

Senior SAP Sales and Distribution Consultant São Paulo, Posted:12/3/2025

Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced analyst with expertise in SAP Sales and Distribution processes, and a proven track record of working with SAP S/4, ECC and integration from legacy ERP systems. As a senior analyst of Sales and Distribution (SD), you will be responsible for supporting and optimizing technological solutions related to the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process within SAP environment. You will collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including sales, customer service, finance, manufacturing, logistics, and other IT units and 3rd‑party systems to support day‑to‑day operations successfully.

Responsibilities
  • Sales & Distribution Support: Provide day-to-day functional and operational support for the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) process in SAP S/4HANA & ECC SD, including sales documents, pricing, credit checks, availability checks (ATP), delivery processing, shipping, billing, output management and integration points with MM, WM, and FI.
  • Data Integrity & Integration Support: Maintain and troubleshoot integration points between SAP and legacy or third‑party systems, ensuring data accuracy and process continuity. Support and monitor data and process flows between SD and other modules (FI, MM, WM) and external systems (e.g., Logistics, EDI). Ensure that integration issues are quickly identified and resolved to avoid disruption in the O2C process.
  • Requirements & Enhancements Support: Partner with stakeholders to gather evolving business needs, assess change requests, translate them into functional requirements and work with technical teams. Provide ongoing support for enhancements, ensuring alignment with order‑to‑cash business processes.
  • Testing and Quality Assurance: Participate in regression testing, patch validations, and change impact assessments. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles and maintain quality assurance practices for Sales & Distribution functionalities.
  • Support change management efforts by assisting with user training, maintaining training materials, and facilitating ongoing user adoption. Serve as a point of contact for end‑user support and feedback, helping ensure a smooth transition and continued system optimization.
Job Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. A master's degree or MBA is highly preferred.
  • 5+ years in IT, with a strong focus on technology solutions for order to cash and hands‑on experience with SAP specifically in the areas of sales and distribution.
  • 2+ years of experience in S/4 HANA.
  • In-depth knowledge of the sales distribution processes within SAP, including sales order management, pricing, availability, delivery processing, billing, and invoicing.
  • Proven track record of experience in implementing and supporting SAP S/4 and ECC, specifically in the sales and distribution domain, including project planning, data migration, system configuration, and user training.
  • Proven experience supporting EDI integration within the SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) module, including troubleshooting IDoc processing, resolving interface errors, and coordinating with technical teams to ensure smooth electronic data exchange in the Order‑to‑Cash process.
  • Strong understanding of IT cloud‑based solutions and emerging technologies relevant to OTC and SAP S/4.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, including sales, customer service, logistics, and finance teams.
  • Proficiency in SAP S/4 modules relevant to Sales and Distribution (SD), and integration with other modules.
  • ABAP debugging is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve complex issues and drive process improvements.
  • Professional certifications such as SAP certifications, specifically in SAP SD, and relevant IT certifications (e.g., ITIL, PMP) are a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and delivering results within deadlines.
About Stefanini Group

The Stefanini Group is a global provider of offshore, onshore and near‑shore outsourcing, IT digital consulting, systems integration, application and strategic staffing services to Fortune 1000 enterprises around the world. Our presence is in countries like the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia, with more than 400 clients across a broad spectrum of markets, including financial services, manufacturing, telecommunications, chemical services, technology, public sector, and utilities. Stefanini is a CMM Level 5 IT consulting company with global presence.

description:
Role :

Senior Instrumentation Engineer

Job Description :

We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer with extensive experience in instrumentation utilized for the final control, monitoring, and safety of Gas Plants, NGL Fractionation Plants, Refineries, petrochemical plants, pipelines and distribution facilities, to join the Process Automation and Systems Division, which is part of the Process & Control Systems Department.

Process and Control Systems Department provides services in the field of process engineering, automation, new energy, and digitalization to various entities within Aramco.

As an Instrumentation Engineer your primary role will be to provide instrumentation engineering expertise to the various Aramco entities including designing, developing, installing, and troubleshooting. You will work with different disciplines such as operating sites, instrumentation engineering, facility planning, and project management. Additionally, you are expected to participate in the organization and company initiatives including safety programs, innovation programs, operational excellence, knowledge sharing, self-development, and other programs as required.

Key Responsibilities :
  • Provide support with all types of instrumentation including but not limited to level, temperature, pressure, control valves, Emergency Isolation Valves, Motor Operated Valves, Relief Valves, flow measurement, level gauges, etc.
  • Originate and carry out engineering studies to determine optimal solutions to complex technical problems, increase revenue, reduce cost, and improve process safety.
  • Work with and/or lead task teams assigned to investigate incidents or solve specific technical problems.
  • Undertake special assignments requiring extensive technical experience and discretion when dealing with outside organizations.
  • Develop and maintain Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards, Material Specifications, Procedures, and Best Practices to enhance company profitability, safety, and productivity by applying and interpreting key industry codes and standards relevant to instrumentation and control.
  • Review and evaluate the capabilities of vendors and contractors to determine their acceptability to perform major services for Saudi Aramco.
  • Act as a company representative in technical dealings with vendors, manufacturers, and design firms.
  • Perform technical evaluation for instrumentation quotations and attend technical bid evaluation meetings.
  • Evaluate and introduce best practices and new technologies to enable the company to achieve best-in-class performance in the oil and gas business.
  • Perform cost analyses and value engineering studies to recommend cost-effective solutions to technical issues.
Minimum Requirements :
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering preferably in instrumentation, mechanical, or electrical engineering. A Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering is desired but not required.
  • Minimum 20 years of professional experience as an engineer in charge of technical work in the field of specialty. Previous work with a major international oil & gas company and/or previous employment with one of the instrumentation suppliers used by the company is desired.
  • Must have experience in plant instrumentation sizing and selection (control valves, pressure relief valves, actuators, basic process measurement, etc.).
  • Certified in ISA – Certified Automation Professional (CAP), Certified Functional Safety Professional (CFSP), TUV FSEng, Principles & Practice of Engineering (PE) certification, or Chartered Engineer (C.E.) license or registration.
  • Basic knowledge of H2S, LEL, pH, conductivity, O2 analyzer, CO/CO2 analyzer, fire & gas detectors, and gas chromatographs is preferred.
  • Proficiency in the international codes and standards used within the oil and gas industry, i.e., API, BS, ISO, ASME, ANSI, IEC, ISA, IEEE, etc.
  • Have participated as lead engineer in HAZOP, SIL, P&ID, design, and model reviews.
  • Understanding of control systems, compressor and pump field instrumentation, speed controllers, vibration monitoring systems (VMS), and compressor control systems (CCS).
  • Understanding communication protocols such as DNP3, Modbus, Fieldbus, TCP, IEC, SPA, RP570, ANSI, and general process automation protocols.
  • Have been an active member of a relevant professional society (e.g., ISA, IEEE, etc.) for a minimum of 3 years and have maintained current membership.

Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations.

The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team.

Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions.

The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight

Overall oversight of (a group of) regional CRAs to ensure (site) compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.

Monitoring support visits (Co-monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site / CRA in the satisfactory performance and compliance with standards mentioned above.

May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.g. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)

Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities.

Assist in vendor management activities as required per project.

Perform review of visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management.

Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan.

Proactive management of site and country performance (recruitment, data collection, document collection, TMF review etc.) and inform clinical project team on progress.

Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable.

May include but may not be limited to input on revenue recognition, site payments, and site pass-through expense review.

May be required to manage / oversee investigator sites including CRA responsibilities, on a temporary or permanent basis.

Project Liaison

Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, as well as individual / country CRA calls.

Attend meetings with Study Sponsor to provide status updates on country and site progress.

Provide operational support and guidance to the monitoring team throughout project.

Provide project training / mentoring to regional CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans and guidelines, and timelines for the study.

Ensures study specific training requirements are completed and documented.

First point of contact for regional CRAs for study-specific questions and issues.

Escalates to PM and other functions as appropriate.

Support line managers by providing status updates on utilization and performance of CRAs.

Liaise with line manager for assigning sites to CRAs following line manager allocation of a CRA resource to the project.

Conduct CRA Assessment visits per departmental requirements to assess the performance of the CRA against their monitoring responsibilities.

Study Documents and Plans

Develop training materials and study tools for sites and CRAs, including monitoring plans.

Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies together with clinical project team.

Develop presentation materials for and presents at Sponsor Kickoff meetings, Investigator meetings and Sponsor Calls (as needed), and prepares presentations for Site Qualification Visits and Site Initiation Visits.

Qualifications

College diploma / degree AND 7-9 years related experience + continuous training and knowledge / skills upgrading OR Undergraduate university degree (Bachelors or Honors Bachelors) AND 4-6 years' experience + substantial on-going job-related training.

Other Health Sciences, Life Sciences or Nursing specialty preferred, or SoCRA and / or ACRP Certification / Designation.

Should have a minimum of 3 years CRA experience, have strong experience with EDC systems, be proficient with MS Office, have strong written and verbal communication skills and highly effective interpersonal and organizational skills.

Demonstrate the following attributes: proactive, detail oriented, task-driven and highly organized.

Demonstrate the critical elements of GCPs and local regulations as they relate to clinical monitoring, IRB / EC and Investigator responsibilities.

Demonstrated ability in report writing and strong ability to critically understand clinical research documents.

Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Working Conditions

Home-based.

Accommodations for persons with disabilities are available on request in respect of all aspects of the recruitment and selection lifecycle.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24 / 7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Scope

Senior executive officer responsible for the overall management and legal representation of the company in Brazil, ensuring full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, alignment with group strategy, and sound governance, risk and control frameworks. Acts as the company’s legal representative alongside other three directors before public authorities, regulators, financial institutions and key partners.

Key responsibilities
  • Corporate management : lead the implementation of the business plan in Brazil, follow HQ priorities and ensure operational and financial targets are met.
  • Legal representation : act as the company’s legal representative before the Central Bank of Brazil and other regulators, tax authorities, courts, financial institutions, partners and suppliers, signing contracts, powers of attorney and corporate documents.
  • Regulatory relationship : maintain a constructive and transparent relationship with Brazilian regulators and self-regulatory bodies, including responding to inspections, official inquiries and information requests.
  • Financial stewardship : approve budgets according to HQ instructions, monitor cash flow, capital and liquidity needs, and ensure timely and accurate financial according to the finance team and regulatory reporting.
  • People and culture : build and lead the local leadership team, promote an ethical culture, and ensure adherence to the company’s code of conduct and policies, acting in a horizontal relationship alongside officers responsible for AML / CFT, Internal Controls & Compliance, and Risk, Capital & Disclosure.
Requirements
  • 5+ years of professional experience, with solid background in financial services, payments, fintech and / or crypto, including prior experience in leadership or management roles.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape applicable to the business (Central Bank of Brazil, COAF and, where relevant, CVM and other authorities).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering or a related field; a MBA or similar is a plus.
  • Proven leadership, stakeholder-management and decision-making skills, with a hands‑on, ownership mindset.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must be resident in Brazil.
Disqualifying factors
  • I — not to be barred by special law, nor convicted of bankruptcy crimes, tax evasion, malfeasance, active or passive bribery, extortion, embezzlement, crimes against the popular economy, public faith, property, or the National Financial System, nor sentenced to a penalty that prohibits, even temporarily, access to public office.
  • II — not to have been declared disqualified or suspended from serving in statutory or contractual bodies at institutions authorized to operate by the Central Bank of Brazil or at pension entities, insurance companies, capitalization companies, publicly held companies, or entities subject to the supervision of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Brazil (CVM).
  • III — not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent.
  • IV — unblemished reputation.
  • V — knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities.
  • VI — technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

Since our V2 launched in July, we've been regularly doubling our usage and are desperately in need of another A+ fullstack engineer whose a self-starter and passionate about owning varying problems from web crawlers to CI / CD pipelines to UI as we build out the future of electronic design.

We're looking for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer to be our Swiss Army knife—someone capable of contributing to every layer of our tech stack. From data pipelines to backend services, frontend interfaces, and DevOps infrastructure, you'll have the opportunity to shape and build every aspect of our product.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys solving big challenges, and loves wearing multiple hats while working at a fast-moving startup.

Key Goals
  • Data & AI Pipelines - Maintain and optimize systems to handle data ingestion and processing for AI training.
  • Backend Development - Design and build APIs while optimizing our backend for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Frontend Development - Create responsive, clean, React interfaces based off of Figma Designs
  • DevOps Infrastructure - Establish CI / CD pipelines while maintaining scalability and monitoring costs.
Key Responsibilities
  • Own and improve entire workflows from the database to the frontend.
  • Contribute to data-heavy projects, including web crawlers, data cleaning, and entity resolution.
  • Work closely with the product and AI teams to design and implement new features.
  • Balance building new features with maintaining reliability and scalability as the product grows.
Qualifications

Must-Have Skills :

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software development.
  • 2+ years of experience working with knowledge graphs (e.g. Neo4j)
  • Proficiency in both backend and frontend development.
  • Expertise in Python and modern frameworks like React and Rust.
  • Experience building RESTful APIs and working with cloud platforms (e.g. GCP, AWS).

Should-Have Skills :

  • Experience working in an early-stage startup environment.
  • Proven ability to handle large-scale data pipelines and optimize for performance.
  • Understanding of modern best practices for frontend usability and accessibility.

Nice-to-Have Skills :

  • Experience with Supabase, Retool, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of machine learning pipelines or AI model training.
  • Passion for hardware, electronics, or PCB design.

Soft Skills :

  • Self-Motivation – Take initiative and ownership of your work.
  • Passion – Be excited about solving complex challenges and building meaningful tools.
  • Flexibility – Thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Attention to Detail – Sweat the small stuff without losing sight of the big picture.

Why Join Us?

title: Msf Access Executive Director
description:
Location : Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur).

Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration : MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Apply :

Compensation and benefits : MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to : The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date : Beginning of Q

  • preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters.

MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.

MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF's 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together.

Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees.

We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission.

MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign.

Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities.

While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF's access work.

The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs : Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access's mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access.

The focus of the ED's role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access.

Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director's primary responsibilities will include :

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

We are building a global team that values innovation, impact, and collaboration. As part of a scaling FinTech company, every person on our team has the opportunity to shape our future, influence our products, and make a real difference for our customers.

What We’re Looking For

We're seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our mission of revolutionizing payments for service-based companies by building the robust, scalable infrastructure that powers our accounts receivable automation platform.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on architecting and developing core backend services, design event-driven data pipelines, and ensuring the reliability and performance of systems that process critical financial transactions for our clients.

Working closely with Product and Operations teams, you'll leverage your expertise in Go (or other similar language) and distributed systems to deliver high-quality features rapidly while maintaining the transparency, dependability, and partnership values that define Alternative Payments.

This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on how businesses manage their payment processes, contributing to a platform that reduces costs and complexity for companies while working alongside a global, diverse and collaborative team.

This role is available to candidates who are eligible to work in Brazil, fully remote.

What You’ll Do

  • Build backend services
    Develop and maintain core services that handle data processing, transformations, and business logic.

  • Design event-driven pipelines
    Craft idempotent, queue-based workflows (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.) to process messages without duplication.

  • Write clean, maintainable code
    Author services in Go (or a similar language) and SQL (Postgres or equivalent), following clear coding standards and review practices.

  • Drive quality & reliability
    Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; instrument metrics (throughput, latency, error rates) and alerts; rapidly diagnose and resolve issues.

  • Collaborate & iterate
    Partner with Product and Operations to deliver features quickly; pair with teammates to share knowledge and continuously refine our tooling and processes.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4–7 years in professional software development, with senior-level responsibilities.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Strong in Go (or comparable backend language) and SQL (Postgres or equivalent).

    • Comfortable with event buses/queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).

    • Solid testing discipline: unit, integration and end-to-end.

    • Familiarity with Git workflows, code reviews and CI/CD pipelines.

  • How you like to work:

    • Quick learner who thrives in a fast-moving environment.

    • Detail-oriented problem solver, especially around data consistency.

    • Clear communicator and collaborative team player.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior work on payment platforms or financial/data reconciliation.

  • Hands-on experience integrating with QuickBooks Online, Xero, Netsuite or similar APIs

  • Understanding of accounting principles (e.g. double-entry).

  • Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana).

  • Basic compliance/security exposure (encryption, audit trails).

  • Track record of mentoring, leading projects, or driving organizational improvements.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, dynamic, and high-impact environments .

What we offer

  • Competitive salary

    • The total compensation range for this role is between 72k - 90k USD/year, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

  • Claude Code for our engineering team.

  • Opportunity to work with a global, dynamic and innovative team who truly cares about making a real impact in a rapidly growing industry.

Why Choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Our Values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We operate openly and build trust with customers, investors, and teammates.

  • Dependability: We do what we say we will, consistently and reliably.

  • Partnership: We collaborate across teams and with clients to solve big problems.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge norms to create stronger, safer, and simpler solutions.

  • Diversity & Inclusion: We work together with people of all backgrounds and seek different viewpoints to generate stronger partnerships and create a stronger, more inclusive company and world.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24 / 7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Scope

Senior executive officer responsible for the overall management and legal representation of the company in Brazil, ensuring full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, alignment with group strategy, and sound governance, risk and control frameworks. Acts as the company's legal representative alongside other three directors before public authorities, regulators, financial institutions and key partners.

Key Responsibilities
  • Corporate management: lead the implementation of the business plan in Brazil, follow HQ priorities and ensure operational and financial targets are met.
  • Legal representation: act as the company's legal representative before the Central Bank of Brazil and other regulators, tax authorities, courts, financial institutions, partners and suppliers, signing contracts, powers of attorney and corporate documents.
  • Regulatory relationship: maintain a constructive and transparent relationship with Brazilian regulators and self-regulatory bodies, including responding to inspections, official inquiries and information requests.
  • Financial stewardship: approve budgets according to HQ instructions, monitor cash flow, capital and liquidity needs, and ensure timely and accurate financial data according to the finance team and regulatory reporting.
  • People and culture: build and lead the local leadership team, promote an ethical culture, and ensure adherence to the company's code of conduct and policies, acting in a horizontal relationship alongside officers responsible for AML / CFT, Internal Controls & Compliance, and Risk, Capital & Disclosure.
Requirements
  • 5+ years of professional experience, with solid background in financial services, payments, fintech and / or crypto, including prior experience in leadership or management roles.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape applicable to the business (Central Bank of Brazil, COAF and, where relevant, CVM and other authorities).
  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering or a related field; an MBA or similar is a plus.
  • Proven leadership, stakeholder‑management and decision‑making skills, with a hands‑on, ownership mindset.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must be resident in Brazil.
Disqualifying Factors
  • No disqualifying factors as described below: I — not to be barred by special law, nor convicted of bankruptcy crimes, tax evasion, malfeasance, active or passive bribery, extortion, embezzlement, crimes against the popular economy, public faith, property, or the National Financial System, nor sentenced to a penalty that prohibits, even temporarily, access to public office;
  • II — not to have been declared disqualified or suspended from serving in statutory or contractual bodies at institutions authorized to operate by the Central Bank of Brazil or at pension entities, insurance companies, capitalization companies, publicly held companies, or entities subject to the supervision of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Brazil (CVM);
  • III — not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • IV — unblemished reputation;
  • V — knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • VI — technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

description:
DEIXE-NOS DIZER O QUE NOS TORNA GENUÍNOS…

Procuramos profissionais que queiram se reinventar a cada dia, que queiram enfrentar desafios em seu DNA e que sejam apaixonados por trabalhar com tecnologia / cibersegurança. Isso nos torna únicos e autênticos.

O que buscamos? Procuramos um profissional Arquiteto SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) SR , para compor nosso time.

O que vai fazer?
  • Criar arquiteturas escaláveis e altamente disponíveis, considerando tolerância a falhas, balanceamento de carga e redundância.
  • Adotar práticas de chaos engineering para validar a resiliência da infraestrutura. Atuar com automação e infraestrutura como Código (Ia C)
  • Definir padrões de automação para provisionamento, configuração e gerenciamento de infraestrutura.
  • Utilizar ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes e Helm.
  • Projetar estratégias de monitoramento proativo usando Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack e outras ferramentas.
  • Criar SLOs (Service Level Objectives), SLIs (Service Level Indicators) e SLAs (Service Level Agreements) para medir a confiabilidade do sistema.
  • Criar processos para resolução rápida de incidentes e resposta a falhas.
  • Desenvolver playbooks e runbooks para automação da resposta a incidentes.
  • Trabalhar na eficiência de uso de recursos, evitando desperdícios na nuvem e melhorando o desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar práticas de Fin Ops para otimizar custos de infraestrutura.
  • Fomentar práticas de CI / CD e integração contínua com pipelines automatizados.
  • Definir processos para rollback seguro, feature flags e testes em produção.
O que é necessário?
  • Experiência como SRE, com ampla vivência em ferramentas de observabilidade, principalmente o Dynatrace
  • Conhecimento em Práticas de Fin Ops com foco em otimização de custos e previsões de produtos
  • Atuação com indicadores Golden Signals ou Page Status
  • Habituado em responder a incidentes críticos e propor ações preventivas para evitar recorrência (Postmortem / RCA)
  • Atuação anterior como Dev Ops ou funções similares
  • Conhecimento em ambiente de Cloud (AWS)
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação e similares, como DQL (Data Query Language) que é subconjunto da SQL (Structured Query Language)
Formação

Superior em tecnologia ou áreas relacionadas.

description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton, Vitta e Collact, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura :

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • ⚡ Own It : Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride : Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  • Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
Como é ser uma pessoa Software Engineer :

Como Software Engineer, você vai realizar entregas de valor participando diretamente do refinamento técnico, contribuindo com as decisões técnicas e fazendo parte do processo de criação da solução. A função de Engenharia é desenvolver soluções que geram impacto positivo na vida dos clientes, transformando ideias e necessidades do mercado em valor tangível, através de produtos de software. Além de garantir a execução de iniciativas que direta ou indiretamente impactam os empreendedores brasileiros e o mercado.

O que esperamos de você :
  • Experiência consolidada em Golang;
  • Experiência direta com desenho de software, estruturação de solução e engenharia de requisitos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos sobre algoritmos e estruturas de dados;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos sobre padrões de projetos (Design Patterns) e SOLID;
O que aumentam suas chances :
  • Experiência com Elastic Search;
  • Conhecimentos de infraestrutura;
  • Conhecimentos de abordagens como : Micro Serviços, Event Sourcing, CQRS, Hexagonal Architecture, Lambda Architecture;
  • Experiência com modelagens Relacionais e não Relacionais;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de CI / CD, Azure DevOps;
  • Conhecimento e interesse no mercado financeiro.
Nossos benefícios :
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta : médicos, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, na palma da sua mão.
  • Vale Refeição e / ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (exclusivo para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • ✏ Benefício Educação
  • Gympass
  • Auxílio Creche
  • PLR
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)
Etapas do Processo Seletivo :
  • ✍ Inscrição : Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Entrevistas com o time de People : Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Avaliação Técnica : Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • ✅ Check de Cultura : Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback : Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente! Caso queira saber mais :

description:
Job Overview

Associate Clinical Leads are an integral part of clinical trial delivery, working alongside clinical teams to improve patients’ lives by bringing new drugs to the market faster. The Associate Clinical Lead is a member of the core project team responsible for clinical delivery of clinical studies to meet contractual requirements in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies and practices. Associate Clinical Leads partner with Project Leaders and other functional teams to ensure delivery requirements are met at all times.

Essential Functions
  • Ensure clinical delivery of assigned projects in compliance with regulatory requirements (International Conference on Harmonization (ICH)-Good Clinical Practice (GCP), protocol), customer requirements (contract), and internal requirements (policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), project plans).
  • Accountable for meeting projects’ recruitment targets and ensuring appropriate recruitment strategies are in place.
  • Contribute to the development of the project risk mitigation plan and manage clinical risks throughout the project’s lifecycle.
  • Ensure clinical quality delivery by identifying quality standards/requirements, planning how compliance will be measured, monitoring and overseeing management of clinical quality issues.
  • Manage clinical aspects of Project Finances including Estimate at Completion (EAC). Understand the scope of clinical delivery and create plans to deliver. Monitor and manage changes against baseline Estimate at Completion (EAC) and identify additional service opportunities or out of scope work.
  • Identify clinical stakeholder landscape for the project and manage both internal and external stakeholders through effective communication and resolution management.
  • Collaborate with the clinical team to support milestone achievements. Report to internal and external stakeholders as per project scope requirements.
  • Resourcing and Talent Planning of the clinical team. Manage the clinical team at project level to successfully deliver the project through the establishment of high-quality operational plans and guidance and project related trainings.
  • Conduct regular team meetings and communicate appropriately to achieve objectives.
  • Support professional development by providing feedback to clinical team line managers on performance relative to project tasks.
  • May work as the sole Clinical Lead on projects with 1-2 service lines and single/few countries or alongside more senior Clinical Leads to deliver large, global trials.
  • May attend site visits as applicable in support of project delivery.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree in health care or other scientific discipline.
  • Requires 3 years clinical research/monitoring experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  • Requires good knowledge of applicable clinical research regulatory requirements i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
  • Requires broad protocol knowledge and therapeutic knowledge.
  • Requires good understanding of Clinical Research industry (drug/device/technology/etc.) and the relevant environments in which it operates.
  • Requires basic understanding of project finances.
  • Knowledge of clinical trials – application of applicable clinical research regulatory requirements i.e., International Conference on Harmonization (ICH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and relevant local laws, regulations and guidelines, towards clinical trial conduct.
  • Communication – strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.
  • Problem solving – problem solving skills.
  • Organization – planning, time management and prioritization skills.
  • Prioritization – ability to handle conflicting priorities.
  • Quality – attention to detail and accuracy in work.
  • Results-oriented approach to work delivery and output.
  • IT skills – good software and computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Collaboration – ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients.
  • Cross-collaboration – ability to work across cultures and geographies with a high awareness and understanding of cultural differences.
  • Effective communication – ability to influence without authority.
  • IQVIA Core Competencies – ability to demonstrate all IQVIA competencies (Client Focus, Collaboration, Communication, innovation, Ownership).
